name: Local SHA-256 Checker
tagline: Calculate a file checksum in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
description: A small learning tool inside the SHA-256 verification guide. It uses the browser's Web Crypto API to calculate a file's SHA-256 digest locally and can compare it with a reference checksum you paste in. Files up to 32 MiB are supported to stay safe on phones.
features: Runs locally with the Web Crypto API — no upload, cookies or storage
Optional comparison with a publisher's reference checksum
Works on mobile and desktop browsers
requirements: A browser with Web Crypto support (all current major browsers)

notes: Published inside the SHA-256 verification learning guide

screenshots.alt: The local SHA-256 checker inside the verification guide
screenshots.caption: Captured from the actual guide page

faq.q: Does a matching checksum prove a file is safe?
faq.a: No. It only shows that the bytes match the reference you compared against. Review the source, signature and permissions as well.

privacyNote: Files are processed only on your device.
